label: Membranous nephropathy
summary: Bounded primary (autoantibody-mediated) membranous nephropathy map: podocyte target antigens (PLA2R1, THSD7A and other recently described antigens) lumped as one shared antigen-antibody mechanism, subepithelial immune-complex formation, complement activation, podocyte injury and nephrotic proteinuria. Secondary membranous nephropathy (lupus, malignancy, infection, drug-associated) and therapy efficacy are excluded.
query: ((TITLE_ABS:"membranous nephropathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"membranous glomerulonephritis") AND (TITLE_ABS:PLA2R OR TITLE_ABS:"phospholipase A2 receptor" OR TITLE_ABS:THSD7A OR TITLE_ABS:thrombospondin OR TITLE_ABS:NELL-1 OR TITLE_ABS:semaphorin OR TITLE_ABS:"protocadherin" OR TITLE_ABS:complement OR TITLE_ABS:autoantibody OR TITLE_ABS:autoantibodies))
